operations.evidence: The current contract, canonical HEAD 4b49d1e2fc8e7c1fda70bccd7ca2e227c78e022c, UNCLAIMED owner, sequence 37 checkpoint, same pickup_requested attempt and open H-to-F blocker were verified before writes.
A 15-minute lease was claimed only for official-source and line-by-line website evidence; runtime and business writes remained disabled.
Police.uk crime data freshness was bound to the monthly crime-last-updated endpoint.
The day component of the returned ISO date was ignored because the API defines only the month as meaningful.
The request date or current system month was not substituted for the published latest data month.
Download products were confirmed to be broken down by police force and 2021 LSOA.
The latest outcome category in crime CSVs was kept separate from the optional full outcome-history files.
Outcome-history absence for BTP and PSNI remained an explicit coverage limitation.
The complete archive and mutable latest.zip product were distinguished; reproducible use requires a captured month and hash.
The documented year-month archive URL pattern was recorded for deterministic acquisition.
Custom CSV and JSON subsets were not assumed complete without matching the requested force and month scope to the full archive.
Published longitude and latitude were retained as anonymised rather than incident-exact coordinates.
The Police.uk LSOA code and name were recognised as the LSOA containing the anonymised point, not the original crime address or parcel.
Reported by and Falls within were kept as separate fields because Police.uk states their current equivalence may change.
Last outcome category was retained as the most recent outcome and not a complete case history.
The locate-neighbourhood endpoint was classified as point-to-force-team routing metadata.
Force and force-specific team identifiers were not substituted for an ONS statistical geography code.
ONS names, codes and lookup products were retained as the definitive geography-code source.
Free availability through Open Geography was recorded while still requiring a specific product edition and geography type.
Code History Database live and terminated entities were separated before any geography join.
Geography change history from 1 January 2009 was retained as the effective-date source for successor and predecessor codes.
Hierarchy and equivalent-code records require explicit effective-date semantics and were not treated as automatic current-polygon matches.
Lookup and names-and-codes products were required to carry nine-character GSS codes.
Because the portal normally exposes only latest lookup versions, every acquired file must retain its edition and hash.
A lookup was not assumed exact-fit without metadata specifying its allocation method.
OA, LSOA and MSOA names-and-codes products were used to validate the statistical-geography code domain.
Human-readable geography names were retained as labels and not used as the primary join key.
Recorded-crime time series were required to preserve the impact of recording policy and practice.
Direct comparisons across the 2002 to 2003 National Crime Recording Standard break were rejected.
Recording improvements and discontinuities were retained by offence type rather than treated as uniform underlying-crime change.
CSP, force, region and ONS-code relationships were required to come from the release geographic reference table.
Offence descriptions and group mappings were required to come from the release offence reference table.
Old pre-July-2013 and new post-July-2013 offence groups and subgroups were not merged without version-aware mapping.
Pre-2019 negative quarterly values were preserved as transfer or cancellation adjustments rather than clipped to zero.
Quarterly administrative deductions were reconciled at financial-year level as documented.
Police recorded crime remained classified as official but not accredited official statistics.
The 92.4 percent plus or minus 0.3 national recording-accuracy estimate was retained as inspection evidence and not parcel confidence.
Nine-force engagement findings and variation in recording decisions, guidance, IT systems and QA were retained as non-universal quality evidence.
Domains, raw scores, ranks-deciles-denominators, indicators and transformed scores remained separate; 33,755-area ranks and deciles remained relative with no definitive deprived cut-off.

All 12 candidates remain unjoined at confidence zero; source rows 153-170 and operation rows 463-502 were published without a second runner, task, candidate value, business row, database write, migration or deployment.
